description: Find free and free-to-start data sources (financial markets, global macro, energy, agriculture and food, money flows, transport and shipping, weather, news & RSS, OSINT, cyber threat), tools and models in the Signal Lab catalog by text and by filters (domain, category, type, access badge, sign-up needed, license, task, verified, verified_since; see list_filters for the values). Returns up to 25 summary rows in name order, each with lastVerified and sitePageUrl. Use get_entry for every field of one entry, export_catalog for the whole list, get_source_urls for provider and terms links.

auth.description: What sign-up is needed, as the catalog records it, for example none or free API key

badge.description: Access type: Free, Open Source, Freemium or Unofficial

category.description: The catalog's category, for example Market Data or Macro

domain.description: Data domain: Financial, Global Macro, Energy, Agriculture & Food, Money Flows, Transport & Shipping, Weather, News & RSS, OSINT or Cyber Threat

license.description: The catalog's license value, for example Provider terms or MIT

query.description: Words that must all appear in the name, slug, category, domain, coverage, license, license note or tasks

task.description: One task tag, for example macro or market-data

type.description: Kind of entry, for example Dataset or Tool

verified.description: true: only entries counted as Verified resources in llms.txt; false: only the others (Signal Lab originals, license unknown)

verified_since.description: Only entries whose lastVerified date is on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: search_catalog
title: Search the catalog
